title: Identifying ion and carrier behavior in perovskite solar cells through impedance spectra
task: Deconvolve ionic and carrier contributions to impedance spectroscopy in perovskite solar cells
key_results: Low-frequency semicircle governed by ion migration, high-frequency by carrier transport; ion-mobility increase shifts low-frequency features toward higher frequencies; recombination-rate increase shifts high-frequency features
comments: Drift-diffusion simulations clarify impedance interpretation, but experimental validation against actual devices would strengthen transferability.

model_io.model: Drift-diffusion model with ion migration

hypotheses.hypothesis: Low-frequency impedance feature arises from ion migration
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; feature disappears when ion migration is suppressed

hypotheses.hypothesis: High-frequency feature correlates with carrier recombination
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; recombination-rate increase shifts high-frequency peak to higher frequencies
